reviews.comment: I would not take this professor. The grading and assistance are done by the assigned TA. If you win the TA lottery you will do well as they are not consistent in their grading or responsiveness. I addressed with the professor and he did not rectify or address my concerns.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I took Peterson for PHIL-251 in the spring of 2022. While the class was difficult, the TAs are OUTSTANDING, and they do an amazing job of breaking down the complex lectures taught throughout the week during Friday recitations. I would gladly take this class again, given the opportunity.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Lectures are often boring and confusing. I wouldn't take this class again unless I was absolutely forced to. Martin is very intellectual and he knows a lot about philosophy, but the lectures do not help on top of the fact that you can only miss class and recitation 3 times before 2.5% is knocked off your grade for each absence.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Test heavy

reviews.comment: class is discussion-based but tests are material based so they do not correlate. 2 exams each worth 25% and the class prepares you 0% for the exams. very much teach yourself everything imaginable about Phil in the hopes of knowing the material for the exam with ambiguously worded qs. can only miss class 3 times before 2.5% off class grade per skip
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader
